issues.detail: The Transactions widget chips and Tasks Incomplete/Completed chips behave like tabs but are exposed as role=menuitem buttons with no tablist or selected state. The avatar menu button and the four widget kebab buttons have no accessible name.
issues.evidence: Dashboard: 5 <button role="menuitem"> chips (Recent … Operating expenses), 0 [role=tablist]. Avatar <button aria-haspopup="menu" class="_menuButton_ko7ja_21"> with no aria-label, img alt="". Kebabs: 4× <button aria-haspopup="menu" class="… _menuButton_ok3n2_7"> with no aria-label or text. Verifier (2026-10-01): confirmed on the live demo.
issues.title: Filter chips, avatar and widget kebabs lack proper semantics

issues.detail: The same widget family mixes superscript cents, inline cents and abbreviated amounts. Accounts rows show '$200,000.00' with superscript cents, but the hover tooltip for that same row shows '$200,000.00' inline; the Disputes widget shows '$3,444.23' inline; the balance table's 'Pending transfers $71,764.10' is inline while its siblings are superscript; the Invoicing widget puts 'Overdue 4 · $950.00' (superscript) next to 'Paid 12 · $6K' and 'Open 12 items · $12.3K' (abbreviated). Search results and the payment review hero ('$1,042.95', 34px Arcadia Display) also drop the superscript used by the Home hero.
issues.evidence: Accounts row: span._superscript_1of3b_35 (15px parent, 10.95px sup, top -2.9px). Hero: 28px Arcadia Display, sup 20.44px. Pending transfers: 13px, fraction span has no _superscript class. Disputes '$3,444.23 at 3 merchants': plain 12px text node. Search '$1,952.15': 15px, fraction span with empty class. Payment review: span._titleHero_qaod7_12 34px/380 plain text '$1,042.95'.
issues.title: Cents shown three different ways on Home

issues.detail: The ••• buttons on API Tokens expose no text or aria-label, so a screen reader announces three identical unnamed buttons with no token to tell them apart.
issues.evidence: Accessibility snapshot: each token row ends with 'button [expanded=false]' containing 'button' with no name. eval: 11 buttons in the page with empty innerText and no aria-label. Verifier (2026-10-01): confirmed on the live demo.
issues.title: API token row menus have no accessible name

issues.detail: Settings success toasts use the same component but two sentence styles: full sentences ending in a period, and terse fragments with no period. One toast adds 'successfully'; another uses a colon label.
issues.evidence: Exact toast strings: "Your company name has been updated." and "Your Mercury account is now connected to NetSuite." (period) vs "Job title updated", "New role created: AP Clerk" and "Security check-in triggered successfully" (no period). Personal settings add "Your preferred name has been updated." (period) vs "Opted in to SMS notifications" and "Invite sent" (no period).
issues.title: Success toasts disagree on punctuation and phrasing

issues.evidence: axe button-name: Element does not have inner text that is visible to screen readers
issues.title: Missing or unclear name: button in "API Tokens"
